messages:
Maria CSM: Hey team — putting together a compact customer-facing gradebook for onboarding ACME (high-touch). Goal: one-screen checklist for prefill/batching/cache/streaming patterns + renewal signals. Any quick takeaways?
Lee DevEx: +1. Keep it one screen. Include: prefill TTL recommendations, batch sizes by TPS, streaming fallbacks.
Nate SE: For enterprise, suggest: prefill warm pools, client-side jitter, server-side fallback to shorter model. Mention cost tradeoffs.
Priya CS: Also add a short "what to tell PM/customer" line: expected warmup latency, tokens used, when to expect degradation.
Maria CSM: I'm drafting a tiny snippet. Would be great to include a minimal code example for prefill request and a simple health check template.
Lee DevEx: I can paste a minimal SDK snippet. Use the "prefill" endpoint with priority=high. Example:
```json
{
  "action": "prefill",
  "model": "gpt-4o-mini",
  "prefill_ttl_s": 900,
  "batch_target_tokens": 2048
}
```
Nate SE: For batch sizing: recommend 16–64 concurrent small requests or continuous batching with target latency 200–400ms. If client is bursty, enable burst pool and 300s warm TTL.
Priya CS: Renewal-risk note: If 3 consecutive days of >25% failed streams or cold starts >1s, flag as renewal risk and open an escalation. Add a play for early engagement.
Maria CSM: I'll add a two-line "customer message" template for the kickoff email.
Maria CSM: Customer message template: "We'll prefill a warm pool for your top-10 intents, expecting a 0.5–2s tail latency during peak. If you see worse, ping CS and we'll scale pool or adjust batch targets."
Nate SE: Add observability checks: per-route p50/p95/p99, prefix cache hit rate, tokens per successful call, and cost delta after quantization.
Lee DevEx: Also include a simple k6 load test snippet:
```bash
k6 run --vus 50 --duration 60s script.js
```
Priya CS: Where should we store the gradebook? Slack thread + Confluence? I prefer a tiny MD file in the customer's onboarding folder so AEs and PMs can copy.
Maria CSM: Let's place a concise MD in /onboarding-templates and link it in the customer doc. For now I'll paste the final one-liner checklist here.
Maria CSM: CHECKLIST — copyable lines for CS:
- Prefill top-10 user intents (TTL 900–1800s)
- Batch target: 512–2048 tokens, or continuous batching with 200–400ms latency SLO
- Enable streaming for long responses with server fallback to short model
- Warm pool: enable for enterprise with burst policy (300s)
- Observe: p95 latency, cache hit %, failed streams >5% alert
- Renewal flag: 3d degraded perf or sustained cost spike >20%
Maria CSM: @Nate SE @Lee DevEx please review. I want to send to the onboarding PM by EOD.
Lee DevEx: LGTM. Minor tweak: suggest prefill TTL 900–1800s (15–30m) for knowledge-heavy customers — prevents stale context while keeping warm.
Nate SE: Agree. Also include a short "what we will do" bullet: "adjust quantization or route to cheaper model with quality gating" — helpful during renewal conversations.
Maria CSM: Updated checklist and added the "what we will do" line. Done. I'll push to Confluence and paste link here once live.
DeployBot: Link posted: https://confluence.redwood.ai/onboarding/gradebook-acme
Priya CS: Nice. I'll include this in tomorrow's kickoff deck.
Maria CSM: Thanks everyone :pray:
